alex: Heads up — I rolled kernel-selector v2 to cluster-eta at 10:03 and we're seeing ~12% tail regression (p95) for short prompts. digging.

mari: which selection heuristic changed?

alex: it now prefers fused matmul kernels for sequences <= 64. the idea was faster inner loops, but traces show increased KV cache churn and slightly larger microbatches.

tj: can you share a short trace or flame snippet? even a few lines helps.

alex: paste: ```perf: decode loop
  samples: 1200
  top: fused_matmul_kernel 48%
  kv_lookup_hotpath 22%
  allocate_prefetch_buf 8%
  wait_for_admission 12%
```

sana: hmm wait_for_admission up 3x — that points at batch formation/queue policy. did admission adapt to new decode rate?

alex: admission config hasn't changed, but batcher classifier is using older decode-rate cutoffs (fast/med/slow). after kernel change, decode latency per-token changed for short seqs so the classifier may be mislabeling requests.

ken: could be token-budget target misalignment. if the runtime thinks decode-rate is higher, it will push for larger microbatches to hit budget -> more KV pressure.

mari: quick repro idea: run a traffic replay with synthetic short prompts (len 10-40) and force decode throttle off to isolate kernel impact.

tj: +1. also add kv-hit/miss counters in the replay. we need to see if prefetch logic is evicting more often when microbatch grows.

alex: running replay now on canary node. cmd: ```./replay --seed=42 --rate=200 --seq=20-40 --metrics=kv_hits,admission_wait --duration=5m```

ops-bot: deploy noted: replay job 2026-03-18T10:28 started (job id r-87321) :rocket:

alex: initial numbers (first 2m): admission_wait median 9ms -> baseline 3ms, kv_miss rate +15%, avg microbatch 18 -> baseline 10.

sana: that's consistent. So root cause likely classifier thresholds + kernel perf change -> larger microbatches -> KV thrash.

mari: quick mitigation: revert kernel-selector to v1 for short sequences or adjust classifier to use wall-time decode-rate (observed) not historical model.

ken: we can also tighten token-budget target for short-length buckets: reduce target_tokens_for_batch from 1024 -> 512 for seq <= 64. That lowers ideal microbatch size.

tj: I can push a hotfix to admission policy to bias toward latency target instead of throughput for short prompts. small param tweak and canary.

alex: prefer combined approach: (1) push classifier update to use online decode-rate probe, (2) reduce token-budget for short bucket, (3) revert kernel-selector if regressions persist.

mari: sounds good. assign owners? alex owns replay + verification, tj owns admission hotfix, ken owns token-budget change, sana monitors kv metrics and kernel reverts.

alex: FYI I'll post perf artifacts in the eng-runtime thread after replay completes. so far looks actionable. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: alert: canary replay job r-87321 completed (duration 5m). summary: p95 decode latency +11% vs baseline, kv_miss +14%, microbatch_avg +80%.

ken: I'll open a quick PR for token-budget tweak with a short rollout (canary -> 5% -> 50%).

mari: thanks — let's meet 10:45 to sync if regressions don't clear after hotfixes.

alex: noted. meeting tentatively at 10:45.
